howToPlay: Use El Primo's high health to approach enemies and unleash his quick punches. Use his Super to jump into battle or escape, and utilize his Suplex Supplement gadget to control enemy positioning. Combined with El Fuego or Meteor Rush, he excels at disrupting the opposing team.
gears: Equip SPEED and HEALTH to maximize survivability while maneuvering. SUPER CHARGE and DAMAGE are also excellent choices to increase offensive pressure and frequency of Super usage.
trait: This brawler is ideal for players who prefer aggressive close-range combat and want to act as a durable team frontline.
